query C01hProjectTemplates($page: Int!, $limit: Int!, $context: ProjectTemplateContext!) { viewer { projectTemplates(page: $page, limit: $limit, context: $context) { edges { node { id label imageURL requiredLibraries { id namespace name version } } } pageInfo { count startCursor endCursor hasPreviousPage hasNextPage } } } }
